drag-move.title: Drag feedback — move drag
drag-move.target: p95 per pointer move ≤ 16.7 ms; no long task (> 50 ms) during the drag
drag-move.notes: Pointermove (event timeStamp) → first animation frame at which the dragged Clip's ghost start Frame shows the Frame that pointer position means. 100 Clips on two Tracks, 2560×1200 window.

drag-trim.title: Drag feedback — trim drag
drag-trim.target: p95 per pointer move ≤ 16.7 ms; no long task (> 50 ms) during the drag
drag-trim.notes: Pointermove (event timeStamp) → first animation frame at which the dragged Clip's live edge shows the Frame that pointer position means. 100 Clips on two Tracks, 2560×1200 window.

undo-redo.title: Undo and redo — 20 of each
undo-redo.target: p95 key press → settled Timeline ≤ 100 ms
undo-redo.notes: Meta+Z / Shift+Meta+Z keydown (event timeStamp) → first animation frame at which the affected Clip's `data-start-frame` is the one the step restores or re-applies.

preview-after-edit.title: Preview after an edit — 20 Gestures
preview-after-edit.target: p95 from release / key press to the edited Frame in the Preview ≤ 300 ms
preview-after-edit.notes: Release (pointerup) or key press (S) → the `preview-shown` text naming the Playhead's Frame of a Scene newer than before the edit. Keyframe-every-2 s fixture; long-GOP not measured here.

playback-edit-points.title: Playback across Edit points — 2 min, Edit point every 2 s
playback-edit-points.target: skipped Frames ≤ 1%; picture and sound within one Frame (SC-002)
playback-edit-points.notes: Gated on the whole run (stricter than 'at the Edit points') and on the 15 Frames after each Edit point; A/V as av-sync.spec.ts measures it (picture against the sound's own anchor).

two-tracks-full-rate.title: Two Tracks at full rate — 60 s
two-tracks-full-rate.notes: An underrun is a gap in the audio clock between consecutive scheduled nodes, as degrades-picture-not-sound.spec.ts reads it (both Tracks' sound overlaps by design).
